name: 01-landing
caption: Landing — coin screen. Review context: the shell around 67 games is in good shape; this pass focused on what the games themselves do.

name: 02-reversi-color-only
caption: Finding R6 — Reversi is the last color-only board: bare pink/cyan discs with no glyph. Checkers fixed the identical problem with side letters (GAMEPLAY-04); Reversi should adopt the same treatment.

name: 03-checkers-glyph-pattern
caption: The reference pattern — Checkers prints the side letter on every piece, men and kings. Reversi needs this exact class of fix for colorblind players.

name: 04-practice-hub
caption: Finding R7 (new) — the quick-wins branch renamed this header to "PRACTICE · VS CPU" with a catalog cross-link, but main still ships the bare "Demo" header: the branch was only partially merged. Tile VS CPU tags (F-40) did land. Also visible: volume findings R4/R5 — Fibbage draws from a 27-fact deck and Trivia from 60 questions, both below the ~100 burn bar.

name: 05-daily
caption: Stats context — recordMatch is still 2P-only, so party/nPlayer wins (Chain Reaction 4P, Herd, Trivia, Fibbage, Spyfair, Sketch) never reach users/{uid}/stats or the friends leaderboard. Extending recordMatch is the cheapest retention win left.

name: 06-home-catalog
caption: Hygiene — the catalog is at 67 registry entries while backlog.md still shows Arrows work in-flight and UX-IMPROVEMENTS.md lists F-39..F-46 as Open though shipped. Docs lag the code by a full game wave.
